triples.tail_surface: Gouges or marks made by large, hard particles; a rapid wearing away of bushings from very small abrasives; or anything in between.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 大硬颗粒造成的划痕或痕迹；微小磨料导致衬套快速磨损；或介于两者之间
triples.evidence_text: SEVISARBA Gouges or marks made by large, hard particles; a rapid wearing away of bushings from very small abrasives; or anything in between.

triples.tail_surface: Flush the system with the pump removed. Install strainer in suction line. Most abrasive objects and particulate is removed after a few cycles (or days) of flushing.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆泵冲洗系统；在吸入管路安装过滤器；冲洗数次后大部分磨料被清除
triples.evidence_text: SEVISARBA Flush the system with the pump removed. Install strainer in suction line. Most abrasive objects and particulate is removed after a few cycles (or days) of flushing.

triples.tail_surface: Rust, pitting or metal appears to be “eaten” away.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 锈蚀、点蚀或金属被“侵蚀”
triples.evidence_text: NOISORROC Rust, pitting or metal appears to be “eaten” away.

triples.tail_surface: Check the Viking General Catalog Liquid List for materials of construction recommendation. Consider whether all of the materials used in pump construction were attacked; consider other materials used in the system to determine how they resisted the liquid. Check to see whether or not the liquid has been contaminated to make it more corrosive than anticipated.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 查阅Viking通用目录液体清单获取材料建议；检查泵体材料是否均受侵蚀；评估系统其他材料耐蚀性；核查液体是否污染致腐蚀性增强
triples.evidence_text: NOISORROC Check the Viking General Catalog Liquid List for materials of construction recommendation. Consider whether all of the materials used in pump construction were attacked; consider other materials used in the system to determine how they resisted the liquid. Check to see whether or not the liquid has been contaminated to make it more corrosive than anticipated.

triples.tail_surface: Noisy operation, broken bushings, twisted shaft, parts show evidence of high heat (discoloration).
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 运行噪声大、衬套断裂、轴扭曲、零件显示高温迹象（变色）
triples.evidence_text: GNIDEECXE GNITAREPO STIMIL Noisy operation, broken bushings, twisted shaft, parts show evidence of high heat (discoloration).

triples.tail_surface: Review General Catalog for operating limits on particular model involved.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 查阅通用目录确认相关型号的运行限值
triples.evidence_text: GNIDEECXE GNITAREPO STIMIL Review General Catalog for operating limits on particular model involved.

triples.tail_surface: Pump may stall. Evidence of heavy contact between end of rotor teeth and head or other parts.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵可能失速；转子齿端与泵头或其他部件有严重接触痕迹
triples.evidence_text: TNEICIFFUSNI ARTXE ECNARAELC Pump may stall. Evidence of heavy contact between end of rotor teeth and head or other parts.

triples.tail_surface: Increase end clearance and/ or contact your Viking Pump® representative with details of the application, so that information regarding proper extra clearance may be provided.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 增大端面间隙和/或联系Viking Pump代表提供应用详情以获取正确间隙信息
triples.evidence_text: TNEICIFFUSNI ARTXE ECNARAELC Increase end clearance and/ or contact your Viking Pump® representative with details of the application, so that information regarding proper extra clearance may be provided.

triples.tail_surface: Noisy bearings, localized heating at bearings or lip seal, smoke, rapid bushing wear.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承噪声、轴承或唇封局部发热、冒烟、衬套快速磨损
triples.evidence_text: FO KCAL NOITACIRBUL Noisy bearings, localized heating at bearings or lip seal, smoke, rapid bushing wear.

triples.tail_surface: Be sure all grease fittings are greased before starting, and instructions for lubrication of drive equipment are followed; consider use of auxiliary lubricating equipment.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 启动前确保所有注油嘴已注脂并遵循驱动设备润滑说明；考虑使用辅助润滑设备
triples.evidence_text: FO KCAL NOITACIRBUL Be sure all grease fittings are greased before starting, and instructions for lubrication of drive equipment are followed; consider use of auxiliary lubricating equipment.

triples.tail_surface: Wear on only one part of a surface, e.g., one side of the casing, one side of the packing gland, only a portion of the face of the head.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 表面单侧磨损，如壳体一侧、填料函一侧或泵头端面局部
triples.evidence_text: TNEMNGILASIM Wear on only one part of a surface, e.g., one side of the casing, one side of the packing gland, only a portion of the face of the head.

triples.tail_surface: Double check alignment of drive equipment and piping. Check the alignment under conditions as close to operating conditions as possible.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 复核驱动设备和管路对中；在接近工况条件下检查对中
triples.evidence_text: TNEMNGILASIM Double check alignment of drive equipment and piping. Check the alignment under conditions as close to operating conditions as possible.

triples.tail_surface: Pump stalls because parts have uneven expansion caused by frictional heat; galling between surfaces having relative motion; seal seats and idler pins changing color because of high heat.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 因摩擦热导致零件不均匀膨胀而失速；相对运动表面间咬合；密封座和惰轮销因高温变色
triples.evidence_text: YRD NUR Pump stalls because parts have uneven expansion caused by frictional heat; galling between surfaces having relative motion; seal seats and idler pins changing color because of high heat.

triples.tail_surface: Be sure there is liquid in the system at the time of start up. Provide some kind of automatic alarm or shut-off if supply tank runs dry.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 启动时确保系统内有液体；供给罐干涸时设置自动报警或停机
triples.evidence_text: YRD NUR Be sure there is liquid in the system at the time of start up. Provide some kind of automatic alarm or shut-off if supply tank runs dry.

triples.tail_surface: Grease all grease fittings after every 500 hours of operation. If service is severe, grease more often. Do it gently with a hand gun until the grease exiting the lip seal or relief plug is similar in consistency and color to the new grease.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 每运行500小时对所有注油嘴注脂；工况恶劣时增加频次；用手动注油枪轻柔注脂直至唇封或泄放塞处溢出的油脂与新脂稠度和颜色一致
triples.evidence_text: A. Lubrication - Grease all grease fittings after every 500 hours of operation. If service is severe, grease more often. Do it gently with a hand gun until the grease exiting the lip seal or relief plug is similar in consistency and color to the new grease.

triples.tail_surface: greased every 500 hours of operation with a lubricating fluid compatible with the process fluid
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 每500小时用与工艺流体兼容的润滑液进行润滑
triples.evidence_text: O-Pro™ seals should also be greased every 500 hours of operation with a lubricating fluid compatible with the process fluid.

triples.tail_surface: Occasional packing adjustment may be required to keep leakage to a slight weep. If impossible to reduce leakage by gentle tightening, replace packing or use different type.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 偶尔调整填料以保持轻微渗漏；若轻紧无法减少泄漏则更换填料或改用其他类型
triples.evidence_text: B. Packing Adjustment - Occasional packing adjustment may be required to keep leakage to a slight weep. If impossible to reduce leakage by gentle tightening, replace packing or use different type.

triples.tail_surface: Resetting end clearance will normally improve pump performance.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 重新设定端面间隙通常可改善泵性能
triples.evidence_text: C. End Clearance Adjustment - After long service, the running clearance between the end of the rotor teeth and the head may have increased through wear. This wear may cause a loss of capacity or pressure. Resetting end clearance will normally improve pump performance.

triples.head_surface: idler and bushing and head and pin
triples.tail_surface: Periodically remove the head, examine idler and bushing and head and pin for wear.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 定期拆卸泵头，检查惰轮、衬套、泵头和销的磨损情况
triples.evidence_text: D. Examine Internal Parts - Periodically remove the head, examine idler and bushing and head and pin for wear.

triples.tail_surface: If pump is to be stored or not used for six months or more, pump must be drained, and a light coat of non-detergent SAE 30 weight oil must be applied to all internal pump parts. Lubricate fittings and apply grease to pump shaft extension. Viking suggests rotating pump shaft by hand one complete revolution every 30 days to circulate the oil. Retighten all gasketed joints before using the pump.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 停用或存放六个月以上时排空泵内液体，对所有内部零件涂薄层非洗涤剂SAE 30机油；润滑注油嘴并对泵轴伸涂脂；建议每30天手动盘车一圈以循环油；使用前重新紧固所有垫片连接
triples.evidence_text: F. Storage - If pump is to be stored or not used for six months or more, pump must be drained, and a light coat of non-detergent SAE 30 weight oil must be applied to all internal pump parts. Lubricate fittings and apply grease to pump shaft extension. Viking suggests rotating pump shaft by hand one complete revolution every 30 days to circulate the oil. Retighten all gasketed joints before using the pump.
